newsitem.title: UNITED ARAB EMIRATES: Arafat meets United Arab Emirates President.
newsitem.headline: Arafat meets United Arab Emirates President.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat held talks with United Arab Emirates Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on Saturday, the official WAM news agency reported.
It said Arafat congratulated Sheikh Zaid on his recovery from neck surgery and the UAE's upcoming celebrations of 25 years of independence.

The 78-year-old Sheikh Zaid had surgery in September in the United States. He spent two months convalescing in Spain and Morocco before returning to Abu Dhabi in time to celebrate his 30 years of rule on December 2.
The Palestinian ambassador in Amman, Omar al-Khatib, said earlier that Arafat would also brief Sheikh Zaid on the latest developments in the Middle East peace process.
Arafat would head for Qatar later on Saturday, Khatib said.
He said Arafat crossed into Jordan from Palestinian-ruled Jericho early on Saturday.

He was met at the Allenby Bridge by Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti and briefed him on the Palestinians' stalled talks with Israel on the long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.
Arafat, in a speech delivered on Friday by the PLO's United Nations observer, accused the Israeli government of "intransigence, procrastination and circumvention."
